0.why: LoudnessCV.cpp:68 writes channel 1 alone; LoudnessCV.cpp:63 clamps the scaled difference to -10V and 10V

comment: Read from src/LoudnessCV.cpp at commit fb01326, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.11.1, alongside docs/Cella_Manual.md written for 2.11.0. The manual's account matches the code. The scale parameter is two to the power of a value from -3 to 1 (LoudnessCV.cpp:25), so the travel runs 0.125V to 2V per loudness unit with 0.5V at the default. The expander reads its meter over Rack's expander message channel and puts out 0V whenever there is no compatible module immediately to its left (LoudnessCV.cpp:37 and 42). The panel prints M, S, SCL and the two output-mode signs, with no fuller wording anywhere on it.
